meta.title: MapleStory patch ledger - GMS live vs KMS ahead
meta.purpose: Ground truth for what is LIVE in GMS, kept physically separate from what Korea has and GMS does not. Written because data/classes.json was stamped v.269 by construction and the app could not tell a stale record from a wrong one, and because a Korean announcement was once one careless edit away from corrupting the meso model.
meta.builtBy: research wave reading official sources directly; see each entry's route
meta.worldAssumption: Heroic (Reboot) unless an entry says otherwise
meta.hardRule: GMS OFFICIAL PATCH NOTES are the only ground truth for what is live. KMS sources are a roadmap, never truth. Never write 'this is how it works' from a Korean source; write 'Korea has this as of <date>; GMS does not yet.' If it cannot be confirmed for GMS, status is 'unknown' and it goes in unresolved.

fieldContract.status: 'live' | 'upcoming' | 'unknown' - live means confirmed live in the stated region
fieldContract.route: how the source was actually obtained, because the official GMS page does not fetch
fieldContract.corroborated: true = an INDEPENDENT source carries the same claim. false = carried only by the official Nexon page, which is primary ground truth and outranks any repost. false means single-sourced, not doubtful.

layers.live: GMS-confirmed changes, by patch version, each with source and route.
layers.upcoming: KMS-ahead items: what Korea has, when, whether it has SHIPPED in KMS or is only announced, and an explicit statement that GMS does not have it and may receive it altered or not at all.
layers.negativeConstraints: Things a future contributor might 'helpfully' add from a headline that are NOT true of GMS. Read this before changing any constant.
layers.unresolved: Anything that could not be confirmed either way. An honest unknown is useful; a confident mislabel is not.

classBalance.shape: The overwhelming bulk of v.271 class balance is a per-class retune of four shared common-core skills that previously used one flat value for every class. classBalance.unitNote: All values are skill damage percentages as printed. Each new value replaces the old shared baseline above. null means the official page listed no line for that skill for that class.

changes.summary: SPECIAL SKILL RING REBALANCE - affects every class, large power swing.
changes.detail: Ring of Restraint: Attack Power and Magic ATT (Lv.6) 95% -> 85%, zone range about +95%, re-cast now recreates the zone. Continuous Ring: duration 8s -> 30s, Boss Damage (Lv.6) 195% -> 54%, cooldown REMOVED, and using skills (with exceptions) now temporarily increases Attack Power, Magic ATT and Boss Damage. Master Level 6 -> 4 with value cuts: Critical Damage Ring (Crit Damage Lv.4 24% -> 20%), Totalling Ring (Main Stat Lv.4 1.6% -> 1.2%), Risk Taker Ring (ATT/Magic ATT Lv.4 40% -> 30%), Weapon Jump S/D/I/L Rings (STR/DEX/INT/LUK Lv.4 320% -> 260%). NEW: an additional Special Skill Ring slot unlocked by equipping a Lv.4+ Ring of Restraint or Lv.4+ Continuous Ring - one Active and one Passive ring, and using the active ring also activates the passive ring's effects. REMOVED: Swap Rings skill, Ring Activation skill, Reserve Special Skill Ring slot, Ring Activation from Buff Favorites. Equipping a Special Skill Ring now applies the maximum cooldown to its usable skill.
changes.economics: Lv.5/Lv.6 Critical Damage / Totalling / Risk Taker / Weapon Jump rings owned before the 2026-09-09 maintenance were converted to Lv.4 with compensation (Lv.5: 10x Grindstone of Life + 5,000,000,000 mesos; Lv.6: 10x Grindstone of Life + 20x Grindstone of Faith + 25,000,000,000 mesos), claimable until 2027-09-08. Ring Polish Swap cost changed to 50,000,000 mesos and the Ring Polish Swap feature will be REMOVED in the November 2026 update. Polishing caps: up to 10 Grindstones of Life at once (+10% success each, 500,000,000 mesos each) and up to 20 Grindstones of Faith at once (+5% success each, 1,000,000,000 mesos each). These meso figures belong to the meso model, not the class model.

themes: Damage-oriented PARTY SYNERGY buffs stripped out and partially returned as personal buffs: Dark Knight Beholder party attack/defense/accuracy removed; Wild Hunter Sharp Eyes party crit removed; Battle Mage Yellow Aura party attack speed removed; Cannoneer Monkey Magic party buffs removed (replaced by a personal 'Monkey's Blessing' passive); Bishop Resurrection no longer applies a party damage buff.

Movement/rush skills converted from combat skills into pure mobility that grants a PERMANENT attack-power passive, plus cancel functionality (Hero/Paladin/Dark Knight rush; Bowmaster/Marksman/Pathfinder Double Jump; Kaiser Piercing Rush).
Several summon and installation skills converted into persistent or passive effects (Ice/Lightning Thunder Sphere becomes fixed damage, 296% -> 466%; Cannoneer Support Monkey duration 60s -> 600s).
notableClasses: Xenon - the single largest nerf. Opartz Code final damage 32% -> 5%; Triangle Formation 340% -> 166% (and loses its accuracy debuff); Snipe 340% -> 286%; Mega Smasher 660% -> 627%; Installation Smasher 550% -> 523%; Photon Ray 880% -> 827%. Inven's community measurement puts the net at roughly -13% real DPS.

Xenon symbol conversion RAISED as compensation: Arcane Symbol 144 -> 198 base and 48 -> 66 per enhancement level; Authentic Symbol 240 -> 330 base and 96 -> 132 per level, with HEXA stat gains scaled proportionally (up to +60% at level 10). HIGHEST GMS-ALTERATION RISK ITEM IN THIS FILE - Xenon uniquely converts symbols into all three main stats, and Heroic symbol acquisition differs from KMS regular worlds.

Pathfinder - the Relic Gauge system is DELETED outright. Relic Charge I and II removed, attack skills move to MP consumption, Relic Materialization triggers on a hit chance requiring 2 attacks instead of 8. A full resource-system rework.

Kaiser - best received. Will of Sword spawn time 70% faster, damage 300% -> 510%; Final Trance cooldown 240s -> 120s with duration 60s -> 30s (uptime holds at 25% but aligns to the 2-minute burst); Piercing Rush becomes utility with a permanent attack-power rider.

Demon Avenger - Exceed max stacks 20 -> 10, Exceed Overload gains 1 per skill instead of 2, Release Overload grants a permanent 20% final damage bonus, Shield Charge deleted and replaced by a new Blood Charge, Blood Fist reworked into a heal/defense hybrid with no HP cost.

Mihile - Royal Guard triggerable by direct body-contact hits, Soul Attack final damage and crit bonuses become permanent. A precursor already shipped in KMS LIVE 1.2.417 (Royal Guard buff duration 20s -> 60s).

Bishop - self-buff vs party-buff distinction removed, Angelic Touch 350% -> 690% with hit count 5 -> 11, new Divine Refinement (stance + ignore defense), Triumph Feather prioritises the highest-HP boss target.
Fire/Poison Arch Mage - Poison Breath DoT 10s -> 30s with the tick 60% -> 275%, Poison Mist DoT 6s -> 30s, new Poison Flare. Ice/Lightning - loses Teleport Mastery, gains Frost Edge.
Battle Mage - Dark Genesis 520% -> 1850% with hit count 8 -> 10, new Aura Enhance and Necrotic Hex (10% ignore defense).
Marksman - True Sniping redesigned, scope targeting narrowed 12 enemies -> 5.
Demon Slayer - Demonic Concentration gains a permanent ignore-defense rider; Demon Awakening enhanced slash 830% -> 893-1170%; Jormungandr summonable in the air and repositions on recast.
Buccaneer - Screw Punch master level 20 -> 10 with MP and damage formulas rescaled plus a downward cancel. Blaster - new Explosion Spurt; the worst-received class in the patch per Inven.
Luminous - new Lachesis Resonance built on the light/dark equilibrium. Illium - primary-skill consolidation, passive charging removed.
